sentences.en: What percentage of illnesses are associated with inadequate diets?
sentences.zh: 与营养不良饮食相关的疾病占多大比例？

sentences.en: Inadequate government support continues to damage many economic sectors in Morocco.
sentences.zh: 政府支持不足继续损害摩洛哥许多经济领域。

sentences.en: The road is inadequate for the amount of traffic which it carries.
sentences.zh: 这条道路对于承载的车流量来说是不够用的。

senses.zh: 不充足的，不适当的 - 不足胜任的，信心不足的 -
不充足地，不适当地；不足胜任地
